title: Build what you learned
description: Implement the request path and the release decision the last two courses described.

days.title: Budget the context window
days.objective: Reserve instructions and the answer first, then fit evidence into whatever tokens remain.

days.title: Fuse two ranked lists
days.objective: Combine retrievers by rank instead of raw score, and see that a document nobody found scores nothing.

days.title: Cut a document into chunks
days.objective: Advance by the stride rather than the chunk size, and let the final chunk be short.

days.title: Assemble an evidence packet
days.objective: Filter for authorization and freshness, drop repeated sources, fit the budget, and refuse when nothing survives.

days.title: Report precision and recall
days.objective: Compute each metric against its own denominator, and handle the case where nothing was flagged.

days.title: Split without leaking
days.objective: Divide records chronologically and discard the embargo window rather than assigning it to either side.

days.title: Find the biggest shift
days.objective: Compare shares rather than counts, so a busy day does not look like drift.

days.title: Decide the release
days.objective: Read the worst slice before the average, then promote, hold, or roll back.
